The '''Ewok Fire Cart''' was a two-wheeled [[cart]] used by [[Ewok/Legends|Ewoks]] on [[Endor/Legends|Endor]] to fight fires. It included a large water barrel and was equipped with two buckets, two ladders, and a stretcher for carrying injured Ewoks. It was pulled by two Ewoks. Among the Ewoks who used the cart were [[Wicket Wystri Warrick/Legends|Wicket W. Warrick]] and [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Kneesaa a Jari Kintaka/Legends|Kneesaa]] of [[Bright Tree Village/Legends|Bright Tree Village]].<ref name="Fire Cart" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Ewok Fire Cart was one of two vehicles released as part of the short-lived [[Wicket the Ewok (toy line)|''Wicket the Ewok'']] toy line from [[Kenner Products|Kenner Preschool]] in [[1984]]. It included exclusive figures of Wicket and Kneesaa in firefighter gear.<ref name="Fire Cart" />
